channel.title: DAWN.COM - Business
channel.description: Business and economy news from Pakistan

item.title: PSX benchmark index gains over 400 points on foreign inflows - DAWN.COM
item.description: The KSE-100 index closed up more than 400 points on Friday as foreign portfolio investors resumed buying in banking and energy stocks.

item.title: Rupee strengthens marginally against dollar in interbank trading
item.description: The Pakistani rupee gained slightly against the US dollar on Thursday amid steady remittance inflows and improved investor sentiment.

item.title: SBP keeps policy rate unchanged citing inflation concerns
item.description: The State Bank of Pakistan held its key policy rate steady, warning that inflationary pressures remain a risk to the outlook.

item.title: FBR misses monthly tax collection target by wide margin
item.description: The Federal Board of Revenue fell short of its July collection target, raising fresh concerns about the annual revenue goal agreed with the IMF.

item.title: Aurangzeb says next IMF tranche expected by September
item.description: Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb told reporters the next IMF loan tranche should be disbursed by early September pending board approval.
